resources.string: Record your routine on this device. No account needed. Your prescribed goal and treatment details can wait.
Choose IN or OUT to start.
Day totals use this fixed accounting zone, including when you travel. Existing records keep their zone. Changing the device zone does not reinterpret your history.
Keep recording now. Add prescribed hours and tray details whenever you know them.
Add your current tray, prescribed interval and tray start for a date estimate. A total also enables tray changes.
A first goal starts when you save it. Earlier time has no target. Target comparisons begin with the next complete day.
Worn %1$d min · removed %2$d min · covered %3$d min · no prescribed goal for this day
Use only the hours prescribed to you. Leave this blank if you do not know them.
Leave anything unknown blank. Dates describe your treatment; saving them never adds earlier wear. An estimate needs current tray, interval and tray start; tray advancement also needs a total.
Treatment start must be on or before the current tray start.

You can correct these details. Recorded schedules and tray history are preserved; corrections apply from the time you save. Once a schedule is recorded, its tray number, total, interval and tray start must stay filled in.
Your prescribed goal is saved. Daily target comparisons start with the next complete day.
Target-based streaks are available after you add prescribed hours. Earlier days remain unscored.
The total must include all trays already recorded in this phase.
Keep the current tray, total, prescribed interval and tray start filled in. An existing recorded schedule cannot be removed here.
Previous tray records, schedule versions and wear events stay unchanged. Corrected details apply from now. A corrected current tray or start date will not reassign earlier wear.
